title: active-articulation-cell
description: The corner of the articulation-cell partition where the claim side is articulated but the token side is not (no, yes), told false - content committed without its anchoring identity. Under token-before-claim ordering this is the off-path corner.

token.description: the token (identity) side is not articulated

off-path.description: under token-before-claim ordering, a claim articulated before its expected prior token lies off the natural progression
